summary: The Egyptian army calls for an end to the massive anti-government demonstrations and Mubarak supporters clash with protesters in Tahrir Square.

NATO airstrike on a villa in Tripoli killed Moammar Khadafy's youngest son Seif al-Arab and three of his grandchildren, while Khadafy and his wife survived uninjured, according to a Libyan government spokesman.

At least 108 people, including 49 children and 34 women, are killed in the Houla massacre in Syria, with the UN Security Council blaming President Bashar Assad's troops for artillery and tank shelling of residential areas while armed civilian militias went house to house killing entire families.

President Ali Abdullah Saleh makes a surprise return to Yemen after nearly four months of recuperating in Saudi Arabia, calling for negotiations and a cease-fire but offering no hint that he would step down.
